name: manual_120a75
claim: When a git merge conflict inside a tracked patch/diff file is purely a hex-abbreviation-length mismatch in an 'index a1b2..c3d4' line (7-char vs 8-char, no real content difference), do not hand-pick a side — regenerate the artifact via its own generator command and re-approve. core.abbrev-driven length can legitimately differ run to run; only the freshly regenerated form is guaranteed self-consistent with what the tool will produce next time.

decisions.notes: Hit resolving PT PR #241's ecc-local-additions.patch merge conflict: initially kept the on-disk 8-char form as-is, but the eventually-pushed, CI-green commit (8f04c4b1) has 7-char abbreviations instead — meaning the correct resolution was to re-run 'save --review'/'save --approve', not manually pick either side of the conflict.
